themes.title: Possible loss of professional identity
themes.interpretation: The student may be feeling a drop in status after leaving a professional career. "It's fine" and "everything is fine" may be covering for how much this matters.

evidence.quote: Back home I was an accountant, but it's fine.
Here nobody knows who I am.
I miss my mother's cooking so much.

themes.title: Eating alone with no one to call
themes.interpretation: The student may have no one nearby to turn to when something goes wrong.

evidence.quote: there is nobody I could call if something went wrong

themes.title: Unsure how to write a U.S. resume
themes.interpretation: The student seems to want to start an internship search but is stuck on U.S. resume conventions.

evidence.quote: The American format is so different, and I don't know what to put or what to leave out.

recommendations.topic: Explore how the student feels about their work history
recommendations.open_question: What did your work look like before you came here?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Invite them to describe their former role before asking about current plans.
based_on_titles: Eating alone with no one to call

recommendations.open_question: Would it help to look at a resume together, or to go to the career office with someone?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Point to resume review at the career office and offer to make the first introduction.
based_on_titles: Unsure how to write a U.S. resume
